program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    color = next(v for v in grid[1] if v != bg)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    start, end = markers[0], markers[-1]
    gates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        counts = {}
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
        triples = [v for v, n in counts.items() if n == 3 and v not in (bg, color)]
        if len(counts) == 2 and len(triples) == 1:
            v = triples[0]
            cols = [c for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == v]
            gates.append((r, cols[1]))
    cr, cc = start
    for gr, gc in gates:
        for r in range(min(cr, gr - 1), max(cr, gr - 1) + 1):
            out[r][cc] = color
        for c in range(min(cc, gc), max(cc, gc) + 1):
            out[gr - 1][c] = color
        out[gr][gc] = color
        cr, cc = gr, gc
    er, ec = end
    for r in range(min(cr, er), max(cr, er) + 1):
        out[r][cc] = color
    for c in range(min(cc, ec), max(cc, ec) + 1):
        out[er][c] = color
    return out
'''
